name: Ledgerleaf
summary: A freelancer money app where every payment is split and the tax share goes into a vault
about: A seven-page money app for freelancers, sole traders and small studios, styled like a ruled paper ledger with a night forest theme. Each payment is split the moment you log it, and the tax share drops into a reserve vault whose dial shows how much of the tax owed so far is covered. It tracks clients, business costs, quarterly tax dates and reminders, with sample data in rupees.
how: Open a page from the tabs: Overview, Payments, Expenses, Tax reserve, Calendar, Clients or Settings
Log a payment and watch it split into your share and the vault, with a coin dropping in
On Tax reserve, drag the what-if slider to test a new split rate, then top up or pay a tax bill
Add business costs to lower your estimated tax; the charts and vault coverage update
Click a calendar day to see deadlines and payments, or add a reminder
Edit the example tax bands in Settings, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data
